title: Last & LastOrDefault
description: Learn to retrieve the last element from collections using Last and LastOrDefault.

data.text: The `Last` and `LastOrDefault` methods return the last element from a collection, or the last element that satisfies a condition.
The `Last` method returns the last element of a collection. If the collection is empty or no element satisfies the condition, it throws an `InvalidOperationException`.

data.title: Last Examples

data.text: The `LastOrDefault` method returns the last element, or the default value if the collection is empty or no element satisfies the condition.

data.title: LastOrDefault Examples
Null Elements
data.text: Be careful with null elements. LastOrDefault may throw an exception when evaluating a condition on a null element.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Last returns the last element or last matching element
Last throws InvalidOperationException if no element found
LastOrDefault returns default value instead of throwing
data.takeaway: Continue to the next lesson to learn about Single and SingleOrDefault.
